acceptance_criteria.description: Mock-backed production-build acceptance covers Cart, Checkout identity boundary, customer-owned address, shipping method and signed Review snapshot without inventing browser-side business authority.
Review submission exercises idempotent Reservation and Order creation followed by payment initiation using the server-only Checkout token and signed payment handoff.
Provider callback state remains server-to-server and is absent from the Payment Return redirect/browser URL; payment result is determined only by authoritative status/verify.
Order Outcome is rendered from authoritative Order and bound Payment state after verify, with no fabricated paid result.
Chromium acceptance at 320px and 1200px verifies Persian RTL, no root horizontal overflow, key 44px targets, keyboard focus and zero automated WCAG violations on accepted Step-63 screens.
Stage H changes only the acceptance harness, package wiring and governance artifacts; runtime app, backend, OpenAPI, database, dependencies, workflows and docs12/docs13 remain unchanged.
Production provider activation/secrets remain deferred to Step 74 and Graph/Graphify final evidence remains deferred only to 63-I before Step 64.

Canonical completion requires exact-head Canonical CI, Phase A, Storefront Quality, deterministic Review, exact-artifact ACTIVE Lock, protected merge, exact-SHA postmerge verification and terminal Lock release before 63-I.
